window: Monday evening, after the DTS224 paper
goal: Module One, which is theory question 1 and the whole of test 1. Three lessons and 137 of the 287 facts, plus thirty of the sixty objective questions already answered.
drill: All 30 test 1 questions live inside these lessons. The methodology selection table is the single most examined thing in the module.

goal: Module Two, theory question 2 and the heaviest diagram work. Fact-finding, use cases, DFDs and ERDs.
drill: Twenty-one of test 2's thirty questions sit here, and ten of them are matching. Learn definitions BESIDE names, not names alone.

window: Tuesday, 8:00 am to 10:00 am, before the CSC242 paper
goal: Module Three, theory question 3. Objects, class diagrams, and the six behavioural diagrams.
drill: Include against extend, aggregation against composition, sequence against collaboration. Three pairs, and all three get asked.

window: Tuesday, 12:30 pm to 2:30 pm, after CSC242 and before this paper at 3pm
goal: The three practicals and the cram sheet. Each theory question carries a practical, so this is the two hours that decide the diagram marks.
drill: Draw the hotel booking scenario from memory: use case diagram, class diagram, sequence diagram, state chart. Then read the trap list in the last fifteen minutes.
